question: What rebates are available for a heat pump?
html:
Heat pump rebates

We can't quote specific heat pump rebates yet. The data behind this site doesn't cover utility, state or federal incentive programs, so any dollar figure here would be a guess. A technician or comfort advisor can check which programs apply to your address when they prepare your estimate.

What we know about your home

Rebates often depend on what you heat with today and where you live. Our market data shows where a heat pump switch is most common:

CountyHomes heating with oil or propane
Perry44.5%
Lebanon37.6%
Berks30.0%
Adams27.7%
Lancaster25.2%

(Punctual Pros market profile)

  • About 241k households in our Central PA core still heat with fuel oil or propane. That is about 390k across all 13 counties we serve (Punctual Pros market profile).
  • Ocean and Monmouth counties in New Jersey are 78-81% utility gas. The options there may differ from our Pennsylvania counties (Punctual Pros market profile).
  • Between 45% and 64% of homes in our core counties were built before 1980. Older homes may also need duct or electrical work alongside a heat pump (Punctual Pros market profile).

What would answer this fully

To give you real numbers, we would need:

  • A current list of utility, state and federal heat pump incentives, sorted by ZIP code.
  • Each program's amount, eligibility rules and the date we last checked it.
  • Whether the incentive pays the contractor directly or pays you after install.

Until we have that list, eligibility and amounts are set by each program, not by us. Ask your advisor to confirm before you sign.

Clear, address-specific rebate answers are the strongest reason for the roughly 241k oil and propane households in the core to book a heat pump estimate. That makes this gap worth closing ahead of any push into Berks, Lebanon and Perry.

Next actions

  • Build and date a ZIP-level incentive table covering every program across the 13 counties. Assign an owner to refresh it on a set schedule.
  • Have the booking script and AI dispatcher capture current heating fuel and ZIP code on every heat pump inquiry.
  • Add a standard "incentives checked" line to heat pump estimates, with the program name and the date it was verified.
  • Track heat pump inquiries from Perry, Lebanon and Berks separately. Use them to size demand from oil and propane homes (est.) before setting targets.
